evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/y extends JFormattedTextField.AbstractFormatterFactory, owns a Map<JFormattedTextField, AbstractFormatter>, and getFormatter(tf) uses computeIfAbsent to cache one formatter per text field.

The factory constructs rs/s/b/x for each field. R14 already reviews rs/s/b/x as IntegerConfigFormatter; that formatter strips the configured unit suffix, parses Integer.valueOf, raises ParseException on invalid integers, and appends the unit on formatting.
The factory constructor stores rs/e/q, the config-unit annotation interface whose method supplies the unit string consumed by IntegerConfigFormatter.

candidates.note: IntegerConfigFormatterFactory is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the formatter factory paired directly with R14 IntegerConfigFormatter. No stronger original source-class identifier is claimed; confidence is 0.997.
